title: VTA PCS — Vetter — Recover — payload
description: A vetter's client asks its VTA to restore the vetter key a community has bound the member to, when the vetter engine holds a different key or none. The VTA searches the keys it can derive for the context and, if one matches, makes it the engine's key.

contextId.description: The context the engine belongs to. Only keys derived from this context's base are searched.

community.description: The community's DID: the helper whose parameters the engine runs under.

memberDid.description: The vetter's member DID in the community.

boundId.description: The PCS identifier the community has bound to the member, as vtc/vetting/vetters/pcs-binding/show/0.1 returns it.

Response.title: VTA PCS — Vetter — Recover — response payload

recovered.description: True when the engine's key was replaced by the bound one; false when the engine already held it.
